data.name: Kim Jiyun
data.summary: Engineer specializing in embedded Linux, system-level validation and reproducible debugging. Designs tests from hypotheses, analyzes logs and traces, and documents failure localization with measurable evidence.

bullets: Created repeatable workload and error-analysis procedures for a DDR5 validation environment.
Reduced manual triage by linking configuration, timestamps and observed failures.

projects.name: CAN-FD Timing Evaluation
bullets: Compared frame arrival jitter across controlled bus load and traffic-pattern scenarios.
Validated conclusions using repeated runs, distributions and documented constraints.

projects.name: Microcontroller Platform
bullets: Implemented firmware and hardware-in-the-loop tests for device communication.

education.note: Coursework: Computer Architecture, Embedded Software, Digital Systems
